notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.notes:
1. Added custom hotkey function.
2. Fix some bugs.

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.notes:
1. The game added more keyboard operations, such as space key to return to the main city, number keys to control the proportion of troops, WSAD control camera movement, etc
2. The deceleration function during construction is added to avoid delaying the fighter during construction.
3. It also gives more tips on the function of small map and building login.

Thanks to players: まなか ねむ, Liomilo for their suggestions!
